top_signals.title: Ukraine says Elon Musk's Starshield service partially restored after restrictions disrupted drone missions
top_signals.summary: The Ukrainian military can again use SpaceX’s Starshield satellite service on the move, a Defense Ministry source told Recorded Future News on Thursday, days after sudden restrictions disrupted drone missions along the front line.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: DeFi Development boosts CHAD dividend to 14% amid push to grow Solana holdings
top_signals.summary: DeFi Development is raising the dividend rate on its CHAD preferred stock to 14% from 13% as it taps CHAD sales to grow its Solana treasury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hybe shares jump 10% as K-pop sensation BTS' tour lifts earnings hopes
top_signals.summary: BTS' world tour and rising global demand for newer K-pop acts are fueling earnings expectations, sending Hybe shares soaring.

top_signals.title: Charlie Cunnion Names as Massport New Port Director
top_signals.summary: The Massachusetts Port Authority (Massport) announced the appointment of Charlie Cunnion as Port Director. Cunnion brings over 25 years of leadership experience across global transportation, supply chain management, operations, organizational transformation, and strategic planning.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
